baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus clause makes what is gathered and retained inwardly the object of divine knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clear apprehension by the named divine knower meets a branch of the focus verb that retains meaning in the heart. The clause therefore concerns an inward archive of intentions, beliefs, and remembered speech, including material that never reaches public expression.

activation_trace.role: The fixed divine name identifies the personal knower and makes the access claim more than an abstract statement about knowledge.
Direct apprehension of what has become clear supplies exhaustive knowing and functions as access to contents unavailable to other observers.
Retention of meaning in the heart supplies the inward archive and makes unspoken intention the known object.

changed_reading.after: God knows the meanings they deliberately gather and keep inward, including intentions and remembered claims that never become speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 4 can make the human subject a vessel carrying an accumulated payload.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel branch materializes concealment as packing and carrying rather than possessing one isolated secret. Juxtaposition with the worshipped divine name lets the payload include operative loyalties as well as deeds, provisions, and claims accumulated around them.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the one treated as worshipped supply an axis of allegiance and let inward cargo include what governs devotion.
Clear knowing functions as complete inventory of the load rather than inference from its visible surface.
Putting goods or provisions into a vessel supplies cumulative loading and turns the subjects themselves into carriers.

changed_reading.before: God knows an unspecified hidden fact.
changed_reading.after: God knows the whole payload of loyalties, deeds, and provisions they have packed into themselves and continue to carry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two branches of the focus verb at word 4 portray inward gathering as either a fracture knitting or a wound filling.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus root does not only distinguish inside from outside; its branch range distinguishes kinds of inward consolidation. What accumulates may restore integrity or may gather as corruption, so divine knowledge becomes diagnostic knowledge of the process and not merely an inventory of contents.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension supplies diagnosis of the inward process and its actual condition.
A broken bone rejoining supplies reparative gathering and functions as one possible trajectory of inward consolidation.
A wound filling with corrupt matter supplies pathological gathering and functions as the competing trajectory.

changed_reading.before: God knows the hidden contents as a neutral store.
changed_reading.after: God knows whether what is gathering inwardly is restoring a fracture or filling an injury with corruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky opens while the earth casts out what it carried and becomes empty. Against that sequence, the focus-side vessel becomes the last closed container in a world moving toward total disclosure; retaining is no longer neutral privacy but a temporary resistance to the surrounding pattern of release.

activation_trace.role: The vessel that holds a load supplies the closed human interior against which the cosmic releases can be read.
Splitting open supplies the first breach of enclosure and initiates the context's disclosure mechanism.
Casting a thing out supplies active expulsion and converts opening into release of contents.
A place stripped and left empty supplies the completed state after disclosure and contrasts with continued inward loading.

structural_cues: The opening and emptying sequence of 84:1-5 precedes the human focus clause and gives its verb a container-disclosure frame.
The earth's object construction about what is inside it parallels the focus clause's object while reversing retention into expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, casting out, emptiness, and a focus-side vessel; I supply the contrast between cosmic compliance and human retention. A live alternative is that the cosmic sequence forecasts eventual human disclosure without implying present resistance.

changed_reading.before: They privately contain material that God already knows.
changed_reading.after: They are still holding a load that the disclosure-pattern of sky and earth says cannot remain enclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Toil leaves scratches, writing joins units, and accounting counts them. These branches turn the focus interior into a pre-documentary ledger: every exertion deposits a trace, traces combine into a record, and the record is already fully known before the external book is received.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points to its object supplies legible evidence and lets knowledge read accumulated traces.
The carrying vessel supplies the archive into which successive traces are deposited.
A scratch or bite-mark supplies the durable trace left by strenuous action and functions as a ledger entry.
Joining one thing to another supplies record construction and gathers separate traces into a book-like whole.
Counting and reckoning supply evaluation of the assembled entries and complete the archive-to-account mechanism.

structural_cues: The toil root is repeated within 84:6, making exertion and its result emphatic.
Books in 84:7 and 84:10 flank the explicit accounting of 84:8, so inscription and reckoning form a local sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scratching, joining, counting, and inward carrying; I infer that exertion deposits evidence into an interior ledger before the book externalizes it. A live alternative is that the book records acts independently rather than materializing the subject's interior.

changed_reading.before: God knows a static collection of concealed deeds.
changed_reading.after: God knows the living ledger they compile as every strenuous act scratches, joins, and adds another countable trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context presents one person returning to family joyful and another formerly joyful among family. The joy root also opens onto inward concealment, so identical social surfaces can contain opposed orientations: joy after accountable return versus joy premised on never returning.

activation_trace.role: Meaning held in the heart supplies the hidden orientation that differentiates two outwardly similar joys.
Turning back toward a destination supplies successful return and gives the first family joy its future direction.
A group of belonging supplies the social setting in which joy becomes visible and shared.
Inward joy and ease supply the affective surface of the favorable return.
The same belonging-group image repeats the social frame while allowing its temporal and moral direction to reverse.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden underside of the second family joy and makes outward sameness diagnostically incomplete.

structural_cues: The near-mirror of returning to family joyfully in 84:9 and having been among family joyfully in 84:13 invites comparison rather than treating joy as self-interpreting.
The second joy is followed by an explicit inward expectation about return, while the first follows completed accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired family joy, return, and a branch joining joy to hidden interiority; I infer that the focus knowledge discriminates the orientation inside the same social affect. A live alternative is that chronology alone, not a different quality of joy, carries the contrast.

changed_reading.before: God knows whether their outward mood is sincere.
changed_reading.after: God knows what temporal and moral orientation each apparently identical family joy contains: accountable return or confidence that return will never occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The book received behind the back spatializes concealment. Branches of behind and back describe hiding beyond appearances, reversing outer and inner, and associating the unseen backside with the heart; the external placement can therefore expose what the subject had relegated behind the visible self.

activation_trace.role: Heart-held meaning supplies the disavowed inward material that later receives a visible back-side position.
Hiding a thing behind what appears supplies deliberate removal from view and functions as spatialized disavowal.
Turning an affair from back to belly supplies an outer-inner reversal and makes placement reveal what concealment inverted.
The branch linking an unseen backside with the heart supplies the bridge from bodily position to inaccessible interiority.

structural_cues: The two book receptions differ chiefly by bodily side and placement, making spatial orientation carry evaluative force.
The focus clause comes after the behind-the-back scene and reopens the question of what remained inward despite an external record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment behind appearances, outside-inside reversal, and a heart/back association; I infer that the book externalizes what was kept behind self-presentation. A live alternative is that the posture marks judgment only and does not represent prior disavowal.

changed_reading.before: God knows what they consciously keep secret.
changed_reading.after: God knows what they have pushed behind the visible self, including material they organize their posture and self-presentation not to face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context names an inward forecast: no return. Conjecture supplies the hidden premise, return supplies the denied trajectory, and heart-sight counters both; what the focus clause says is contained therefore includes the predictive model beneath public rejection, not only its spoken conclusion.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension supplies knowledge of the underlying premise rather than merely observation of its public effects.
A meaning retained in the heart supplies the internal forecast stored beneath behavior and denial.
Conjecture and imagined judgment supply the epistemic premise that the subject treats as a forecast.
Return and reversal supply the precise trajectory denied by the inward forecast.
Insight of the heart supplies penetrative seeing and functions as the counter to the subject's enclosed model.

structural_cues: The causal explanation in 84:14 explicitly locates a proposition beneath the conduct described before it.
The seeing statement in 84:15 answers that inward proposition before the later focus ayah restates divine knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, denied return, heart-sight, and retained meaning; I infer a hidden predictive model that generates the conduct. A live alternative is that the conjecture is already a settled conviction rather than an uncertain hypothesis.

changed_reading.before: God knows that they deny return.
changed_reading.after: God knows the unspoken model packed beneath denial: the expectation that present life will not turn back into encounter and account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night gathers dispersed things, the moon reaches ordered fullness, and the addressees pass through state upon state. These cues revise the focus vessel from a static cache into a phase-built payload: experience is gathered, ordered, layered, and carried forward through transformations.

activation_trace.role: A vessel receiving a load supplies the persistent carrier in which successive phases can accumulate.
Gathering dispersed things into one supplies accumulation and turns nightly collection into a model for inward assembly.
Completion and ordered fullness supply maturation of gathered material rather than mere storage.
One thing mounted over another supplies cumulative superposition and functions as the motion by which the payload gains layers.
State following state supplies temporal sequencing and makes inward content the product of transitions.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from twilight through night's gathering to lunar fullness and then directly to passage through successive states.
The repeated state noun in 84:19 foregrounds serial transformation rather than a single final condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, fullness, superposition, and successive states; I infer that the human interior is assembled across those transitions. A live alternative is that the sequence demonstrates external cosmic order and life stages without mapping accumulation onto the psyche.

changed_reading.before: They carry a fixed stock of secrets.
changed_reading.after: They carry a payload continuously gathered, ordered, and layered by every phase through which they pass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from absent trust, through a gathered recitation, to refused lowering, covering, and attribution of falsehood. The focus interior is thus an active processor, not a sealed box: received meaning is held, prevented from producing embodied submission, covered over, and recoded into denial.

activation_trace.role: Holding meaning in the heart supplies intake and retention, making the interval between hearing and denial inspectable.
Heart-settling assent supplies the missing endpoint and shows that received meaning has not become trusted orientation.
Gathering dispersed material supplies the recitation as an assembled input presented to the hearers.
Bodily lowering supplies the expected embodied output whose refusal exposes a blocked transition from intake to response.
Obscuring truth supplies active covering and functions as the operation performed on the received meaning.
Assigning falsehood to a thing or speaker supplies the outward recoding produced after inward covering.

structural_cues: The question in 84:20 is followed by presented recitation and absent bodily response in 84:21, then a corrective diagnosis in 84:22.
The focus ayah follows immediately, shifting attention from visible refusal to what happens inside the plural subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assent, assembled recitation, lowering, covering, and attribution of falsehood; I supply a directional processing chain from received meaning to rejected output. A live alternative is that rejection is immediate and these are parallel symptoms rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: God knows the unbelief they conceal.
changed_reading.after: God knows the inner conversion by which gathered recitation is retained yet blocked from assent, covered, and returned outward as an accusation of falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's odd somatic fork is activated by the immediate outcomes: painful punishment on one side, and repair, fracture-mending, and non-interruption on the other. Inward gathering can therefore be carried as a diagnostic metaphor for a life knitting into integrity or an injury filling toward pain.

activation_trace.role: Bone knitting after fracture supplies the reparative pole and allows inward accumulation to regain integrity.
A wound filling with corrupt matter supplies the pathological pole and allows accumulation to intensify injury.
Punitive pain supplies the consequence toward which pathological filling develops.
Felt hurt supplies the experiential endpoint and keeps the pathological branch from remaining a purely visual analogy.
Integrity opposed to corruption supplies the ethical distinction between the two kinds of inward consolidation.
Mending a fracture, even when alignment is imperfect, directly reinforces the reparative focus branch and gives reward a restorative contour.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supplies the interruption explicitly negated from the favorable outcome.

structural_cues: The focus clause is immediately followed by punishment and then an exceptive alternative of faithful action and uncut reward.
The two outcomes preserve a fork rather than requiring the focus verb to have only one evaluative charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus root's healing and suppuration branches plus pain, integrity, fracture-mending, and interruption; I infer two moral-somatic trajectories. A live alternative is that storing deeds remains the direct sense and the medical fork is analogy only.

changed_reading.before: God knows how much hidden material they have accumulated.
changed_reading.after: God knows what kind of process their accumulation has become: a fracture knitting toward integrity or an injury filling toward pain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form most readily evokes inward containment while the cited focus branch names raised clamor. It remains anchored to the same focus root and is activated by the nearby call for ruin; downstream prose should present it only as a temporal resonance in which today's silent payload may become tomorrow's audible eruption, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The clamor branch of the focus verb at word 4 lets concealed content be carried as compressed future sound.

activation_trace.role: Raised cries and collective noise supply the audible state into which silent inward pressure may reverse.
Calling out by speech supplies the act of release and turns contained meaning into voiced appeal.
Ruin and destruction supply the cry's content and connect eventual sound to the consequence already latent in the subject.

changed_reading.before: What they contain remains silent and inward.
changed_reading.after: God knows the cry already compressed inside what they contain, before consequence turns it into audible clamor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus verb normally describes what subjects contain, whereas the cited branch pictures many men gathered. It remains anchored in the focus root, the plural subject, and context images of belonging and collection; render it as a collective overlay about socially aggregated assumptions, not as denial of individual inward responsibility.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The many-people-gathered branch at the plural focus verb permits the subjects themselves, not only their contents, to form a container-like collective.

activation_trace.role: Many people assembled supply a collective scale and make the plural subjects a socially reinforcing formation.
A group constituted by closeness and belonging supplies the social boundary within which assumptions can be shared and stabilized.
Gathering dispersed elements into one supplies the aggregation mechanism by which private orientations become group-held content.

changed_reading.before: God knows what each person privately stores.
changed_reading.after: God also knows what the plural collectively assembles and reinforces: group-held assumptions that no single member wholly owns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because the focus branch belongs to an idiom of having no alternative or turning-aside, not the direct transitive focus construction. It remains root-anchored and gains coherence from encounter, return, and successive states; downstream prose should mark it as a secondary inevitability resonance, never as the primary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The no-turning-aside branch of the focus root at word 4 allows the accumulated interior to imply an increasingly unavoidable course.

activation_trace.role: Absence of an alternative or route aside supplies inevitability and makes accumulated orientation constrain future motion.
What a person inevitably meets of good or harm supplies the endpoint toward which the constrained course moves.
Return and reversal supply the direction the subject imagines can be avoided but the sequence restores.
State after state supplies the stepwise route through which stored orientation becomes an unavoidable encounter.

changed_reading.before: God knows the contents they carry while their future remains separate.
changed_reading.after: God knows how the contents they carry are already forming the course from which they will find no way aside.

strongest_changes: Cosmic rupture and terrestrial emptying recast the human interior as the last sealed vessel in a disclosure sequence.
Toil, inscription, and accounting turn inward contents into an accumulating evidentiary ledger rather than a static secret.
The two family joys show that identical social affect can contain opposed expectations about return.
Nightly gathering, fullness, and successive states make the inward payload phase-built and continuously reorganized.
Recitation, refused lowering, covering, and falsification expose an internal processing chain from received meaning to public denial.
The immediate outcome pair activates an exploratory diagnostic fork between reparative knitting and corrupt filling.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's unusually concrete branches made containment dynamic: archive, vessel, repair, suppuration, clamor, inevitability, and even collective gathering could coexist. The context repeatedly supplied opening, gathering, layering, reversal, and paired surfaces, so divine knowledge became knowledge of processes and orientations rather than a generic omniscience formula.
remaining_uncertainties: The direct focus sense does not decide whether the principal stored object is deeds, beliefs, intentions, remembered speech, or all of these together.
The medical, clamor, collective, and no-way-aside activations are visibly anchored but remain branch- or form-distant and should retain explicit exploratory qualification.
The paired joy may differ intrinsically, or the context may place the evaluative contrast entirely in chronology and expectation of return.
The phase-building model may describe inward accumulation, external cosmic order, or both by analogy without collapsing them.
